checklist.evidence: main calls runCLI, which parses flags and calls runTimerFn, which emits initial state before the loop

checklist.promise: Monitor progress with session number and time
checklist.evidence: Timer.emit formats 'Session N: MM:SS' and observed_run shows 'Session 1: 25:00'
Timer.bell writes \a to stderr, but 3s run is too short to trigger transition
runTimerFn catches SIGINT and calls handleSIGINTFn to print count

comments.comment: runTimerFn hardcodes os.Stdout instead of using the writer passed to runCLI, making timer output redirection difficult in tests
